title: Toys 4 Tots Fundraiser
seo_title: Toys 4 Tots Fundraiser at The Vineyard Market, Ozark
description: This holiday fundraiser at The Vineyard Market lets you donate a new, unwrapped toy valued at $20 or more to Toys 4 Tots and receive a complimentary wine flight as a thank-you. The toys help bring holiday joy to children in the community. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026 at 11:00 AM at 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO; reservations are advised by calling (417) 882-0399 or reserving online.
